lines.en: Two legs, broad feet.

lines.zh: 我踩在落叶上，声音很闷。
lines.en: My footfalls sound dull on leaf litter.

lines.zh: 我在花森林里走，鳞色很深。
lines.en: I walk the flower forest, my hide very dark.
I walk more quietly than my kin.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴拖在后面，扫开落叶。
lines.en: My tail drags, clearing the leaves.
I walk toward the patches of light.
I circle the anchor once.

lines.zh: 我的手臂比腿还长一点。
lines.en: My arms are a little longer than my legs.
I move surely through the woods.

lines.zh: 我从一片花里穿过去，花都伏了。
lines.en: I pass through flowers and they bow.
I keep to a trail through the wood.

lines.zh: 我站着，身上的黑鳞吸光。
lines.en: I stand, black scales drinking the light.
This body is at the mature stage.
I listen to the movement in the flowers.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在土上划了一道。
lines.en: My claws scratch the soil once.
The wind carries my scent away.

lines.zh: 我半闭着眼，什么都没放过。
lines.en: Half-lidded, I miss nothing.
I remember being taught to fight.

lines.zh: 我的黑鳞，从头到尾一路。
lines.en: My black scales run head to tail.

lines.zh: 我在锚点周围绕了一圈。
lines.en: I circle once around my anchor.
I am listening to everything.
Under black scales my breathing is faint.

lines.zh: 你是要带我走的那个吗。
lines.en: Are you the one taking me along?
I am taller than I look.
Give an order and I follow it.

lines.zh: 别推，我的爪子会先反应。
lines.en: Don't push; my claws react first.
I can walk behind you.
Do you want me to strike first?
My technique is Tron Flame.

lines.zh: 你想看的话，我可以演示。
lines.en: I can show you, if you like.
I am not a pet.
But I can listen to you.
Call my name and I come.
I grew up in these woods.
I clench my teeth and say nothing.
One stretch back, and I plant my feet.
I have marked where that came from.
A split in my scales.
My breathing is heavier.
My knees still hold.
A crack in black scales, still fighting.
I will repay this eventually.
Forearm up — I'm still standing.
Go on, the second one.
Meat. I want that piece.
Leave it at the roots. I will get it.
Is that all there is?

lines.zh: 我鼻子里的血腥味很重。
lines.en: The smell of blood is heavy in my nose.
Back off three paces first.
I will follow once I have eaten.
This meat has sat too long.
Where is the rest?
I will not snatch from your hand.
Do not watch me.
A few bites and it is gone.
The taste is ordinary.
Give me some room.
That knocked you away.
My scales are hard.
You are standing on my foot.
We need not crowd like this.
Again, and I stop being polite.
Both feet are planted in the soil.
Black armor doesn't fear collisions.

lines.zh: 我是成熟期，还没到那一步。
lines.en: I am mature, but not there yet.
There are some of my kind in this wood.
That depends on whether the other agrees.
I walk with a human now.
Do not say that to me.
I have not thought about it.
Ask when I have changed form.
The wind carries such things off.
Move away a little.
I am going to make a round.
I pick up a bright stone.
It glows in the dark.
I keep it in my claws.
This carcass is mine.

lines.zh: 我这对前爪，抬起来像两支矛。
lines.en: My front claws lift like two spears.
I drag it back in my teeth.
If you want it, take it.
I carry it two steps.
Your shoulder moved.
Black scales to the ground, I lower myself.
I can charge that far.
My throat is warming.
First I watch your hands.
You stand downwind.
I need not shout.
From across the woods, I'm already moving.
You retreated too late.
You have no time left.
I watch the stones you step on.
You go round the tree; I cut the other side.
I stay side-on.
I wait for your opening.
I keep the upwind side.
There's no path by the trees; you're cornered.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴贴着地面拉直。
lines.en: My tail runs straight along the ground.
I close it to two strides.
Your foot slips an inch.
That gap is enough.
I step into that gap.
My forearm sweeps across.
I bite the shoulder and press down.
My forearm is hard.
You took it. Your arms shook.

lines.zh: 我收势，退回原来的位置。
lines.en: I recover and step back to where I stood.

lines.zh: 这一爪收回，下一爪又到。
lines.en: This claw withdraws and the next already comes.
I press two strides in.
I am not even breathing hard.
This round is over.

lines.zh: 黑鳞一寸寸从蕨丛里立起。
lines.en: Black scales rise inch by inch from the ferns.
The first thing I see is flowers. Many flowers.
My scales are black.
I steady myself on two legs.
I try walking out of the tree shade.
Steadier than it looks.
I remember an anchor point.
I walk toward that anchor.
There is someone in these woods.

lines.zh: 我从林子里站起来，不急。
lines.en: I rise out of the woods, unhurried.
I listen a while first.
Then I walk over.
Fire grazes my scales. Hot.
I land on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 气浪把我推得歪向一边。
lines.en: The blast knocks me sideways.

lines.zh: 一枚箭头卡在我小臂上。
lines.en: An arrowhead is stuck in my forearm.
A curse rises and I go cold.
Too long hungry. Less strength.
Black scales crackle, and I lock up.
